column1: # Arabic (ar) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = 6 CLDR forms;
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English labels in Modern Standard Arabic,
# using ordinary vector-illustration vocabulary (لوحة عمل، مسار، نقطة إرساء، حد،
# تعبئة، عينة لون، تدرج، قناع، طبقة). No other application's Arabic localisation
# resource, string table or product UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Conventions: labels use standard Arabic creative suite terminology. Plural rule (CLDR):
# zero|one|two|few|many|other. Status and error messages (`@msg`) keep the case of their English
# first word. Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the tests): the product name
# (VectorCraft), OpenType, the built-in workspace names and perspective grid presets.
# Every `ar-*` locale (ar-SA, ar-EG, ar-AE, ar-MA, ar-KW, etc.) resolves here. Keep the
# placeholders ({name}), trailing "…" and leading/trailing spaces of fragments exactly as they are.
